reviews.text: I brought my dog ​​to this practice for laparoscopic spaying, intrigued by the excellent reviews. I can only confirm: Dr. Cochi and Dr. Pisegna are two exceptional professionals. In addition to their great expertise, they proved to be extremely helpful, empathetic, and reassuring both pre- and post-op.

Lola, our pepper-and-salt miniature schnauzer, is cared for by Dr. Cochi and Dr. Pisegna at the Tre Madonne Veterinary Clinic, and we couldn't be more pleased with our choice.
From our first meeting, we found them to be knowledgeable, helpful, and deeply committed to animal welfare. Each visit is distinguished by their expertise, professionalism, and compassion. We particularly appreciate their willingness to answer any questions and their ability to always provide clear, comprehensive, and detailed explanations, allowing us to approach every decision with peace of mind and confidence.
Special thanks go to the laparoscopic sterilization procedure, which was performed flawlessly. The post-operative recovery was rapid and under constant monitoring, once again confirming the high level of care and attention they provide to their patients. We've also always received prompt, top-quality care for vaccinations, regular checkups, and preventive care advice!
Knowing that Lola is cared for by Dr. Cochi, Dr. Pisegna, and their entire staff gives us great peace of mind. They are professionals who combine expertise, ongoing training, and unwavering dedication with a genuine love for animals—rare qualities that should never be taken for granted.
We highly recommend Ambulatorio Veterinario Tre Madonne to anyone who wants to ensure their four-legged friend receives excellent care and truly special attention!
5 well-deserved stars!
Excellent care and support team for my dog.

The best veterinary doctor in Rome!!
My vote is 100%.
Grateful 🙏  for his experience, patience and understanding!!
Totally recommend!!
For every kind of pet!!
Excellent doctors, very kind to both animal patients and their owners. One of the best veterinary clinics I've ever been to. I would recommend it to anyone.

I've been going to this clinic for years with my cats and dog, first with Klaus and now with the new doctors. The vets who run it are excellent, both young and very experienced, and incredibly gentle with animals. They saved my dog's ear by identifying the problem that others hadn't seen. Highly recommended.
Best in the world.  Dr. Sabrina is extremely helpful, knowledgeable, super friendly, polite and very smart.  Always to the point, she has saved me lot of money.  I am extremely happy with her help.

Excellent care for my elderly cat with some ailments. They immediately connected with him. And, above all, the medical care was perfect (and the anesthesia was very well-calibrated for an elderly kitten)! Thank you so much.

I went to the Tre Madonne clinic for a problem with my dachshund, and they were treated excellently by doctors Federico Cochi and Sabrina Pisegna.
I found them to be highly professional and extremely kind, both to humans and dogs.
I highly recommend them.
Anna Cusani and Bernardo, the dachshund.

We chose Dr. Klaus because a friend recommended him to us. We have a formerly stray border collie of about 3 years old who is extremely sensitive and fearful, and we hesitated to spay her, but after each heat, she was semi-depressive, apathetic, and aggressive toward other dogs for a month. Laparoscopic surgery seemed the least invasive solution, but we were still worried she would gain weight and be less cheerful and playful (her temperament outside of her heat season).

Dr. Klaus was very understanding of our concerns and Lola immediately liked him. They are very empathetic and calm, and their office has a serene atmosphere. Lola never hesitated to come in, even for post-op checkups.

Our friend had told us that his dog left Dr. Klaus as if nothing had happened after the surgery.

It was more difficult for us, but perhaps this happens with any surgery on a sensitive and traumatized dog. However, with the help of a bodysuit and, above all, Dr. Klaus's willingness to see her again, things worked out perfectly. Lola's mood is now consistently cheerful, she plays with other dogs, and, thanks to her careful diet, she has no weight problems.
We therefore strongly recommend laparoscopy for owners who wish to avoid trauma to their dog.
Thank you so much.
Very helpful and patient staff, especially for my yoyo, a malin, a breed that requires a lot of patience. I gave my all because they are very professional, I recommend them.

In my opinion, Dr. Klaus Gunther Friedrich is the best veterinarian in Italy! Five stars is an understatement. Thank you so much for the exceptional work he and his staff do. They are incredibly kind and professional.
The doctors are all friendly and very professional!

Oliver underwent laparoscopic surgery just over a month ago to remove a testicle from his abdomen. From the very first phone conversations, Dr. Klaus stood out for his helpfulness and empathy. It might seem obvious to say this when talking …
